label: Starter, BEL cut under the forearc (50 km line), free reverse trench afterslip in year 1, UNR positions (exploratory MCMC)
description: starter_jt50_belscale_unr with the 30 km BEL cut back where it lay above the Japan Trench mesh (the cut follows the trench mesh's 50 km bottom edge, about 200 km from the trench) and free reverse Japan Trench dip-slip in the first year after Tohoku (prior sigma = the window's 95th-percentile velocity signal) instead of the coupling floor of -50. It fits as well as the scaled-BEL model; the trench afterslip reaches Mw 8.4 by 2 yr and the BEL slips fastest beneath the arc, but about 1 m of first-year afterslip lies inside the main rupture, where onshore data cannot resolve slip: new Noto mesh, UNR IGS20 positions, same 596 GEONET sites and windows
attribution: GNSS: GEONET daily positions, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI).
Coastline: Global Map Japan, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (地球地図日本・国土地理院).
Earthquakes: Global CMT catalog (Dziewonski et al., 1981; Ekström et al., 2012).
